name: Shealtiel
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return

points: The sons of Jeconiah were Assir and Salathiel, and Salathiel's brothers included Pedaiah; whether Assir is a name or a title for the captive makes no difference to the line.
Pedaiah had a son named Zerubbabel; so Salathiel's nephew was also a Zerubbabel, and the name means born in Babylon, a common name for children born in that captivity.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: The sons of Jeconiah are named, and the line is carried through Salathiel, Pedaiah, and Zerubbabel after the captivity.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 3: The Sons of David and the Kings of Judah

points: In the second year of Darius the king came the word of the Lord by Haggai the prophet unto Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest.

Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Joshua the son of Josedech the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the voice of the Lord their God, and the words of Haggai the prophet, and the people did fear before the Lord.
After they were brought to Babylon, Jechonias begat Salathiel and Salathiel begat Zorobabel, both in captivity; a captive does not sit on the throne.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah
